author: Salem Techsperts
description: Companies, take note. NO ONE WANTS THIS. Using generative AI slop to celebrate an era of HUMAN passion that’s now being DESTROYED BY AI, is the ultimate corporate disconnect. It’s a slap in the face. Razer is showing just how out of touch they’ve become with the PC gaming community and tech enthusiasts they claim to represent. I don't normally make videos in this style but this needed to be said.
title: Razer’s "Retro" AI Slop is Insulting #tech #technology #pc #shorts
